description: Visual acceptance fixture for an aperture-bound local volumetric shaft through a three-block-thick 1x2 tunnel, with a four-source lava dense proxy plus two nearby raw lava distractors. The captured image, not READY telemetry, decides success.

captures.name: open-front
captures.visual_expectation: The torch shaft crosses the finite three-block 1x2 tunnel in depth; the four-source lava dense proxy and two raw lava lights must not become camera-fixed orange halos.

captures.name: open-profile
captures.visual_expectation: The three-block-thick 1x2 tunnel produces a finite world-space cone/shaft with visible lateral parallax despite the near-camera lava dense proxy and raw lights.

captures.name: sealed-profile
captures.visual_expectation: No torch shaft crosses the viewer chamber when the full three-block tunnel is sealed; dense and raw lava remain direct local light only.

captures.name: open-air-profile
captures.visual_expectation: No aperture-qualified torch shaft appears without the enclosing divider, even though dense and raw lava distractors remain present.
